dedupe_keys.name: global geospatial ai energy consumer parameters and diagnostics

description: The MUSE-RASA research team publishes five CSV datasets describing energy consumers globally. Files contain clustered and subclustered consumer parameters, silhouette diagnostics, regional comparison errors and within-cluster sums of squares. The public Figshare release dates from December 2024 and is free for the non-commercial use stated by its depositor. These parameters can inform heterogeneous consumer representations in model-muse-os energy-transition simulations. A caveat is that the deposit’s structured licence field says CC BY 4.0, while its title and description specify CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and additional permission requirements. Those conflicting terms need clarification before redistribution or derivative use. The tables are model-derived characterisations, not observations of every household. Geographic aggregation, underlying source periods and cluster assumptions must remain attached to comparisons. No CSV rows were downloaded.
